headline: LAD @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 5.84 at PIT 4.29, with a projected total of 10.13. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (LAD +0.82, PIT +0.68), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +1.50, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -11.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Justin Wrobleski has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Shohei Ohtani, Andy Pages, Freddie Freeman, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Davis Wendzel, Alex Call because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
